text:
Priya R.: Starting POC sync for CurrencyFlow. Use case: streaming transaction ingest -> call an external FX microservice via function/tool calling -> return structured JSON to attach rate + TTL to each txn. They will be on VPC with SAML SSO and expect 30d retention. Timeline: 3 weeks. Need: Go sample for streaming + function call, clear mapping of tool output to structured SDK events, and two pricing options (hosted vs reserved).

Damian L.: Quick check: do they insist on HSM-backed KMS or will cloud KMS suffice? Also confirm whether outbound egress from Private is allowed for the fx microservice.

Priya R.: They prefer HSM if possible; outbound permitted but needs explicit egress whitelist. I'll request IDP metadata and egress CIDR.

Jules K.: Engineering notes: streaming SDK returns discrete event types you can switch on (delta, function_call, end). Function_call payload is a structured string (we recommend JSON schema). Minimal Go example below:

```go
package main
import (
  "context"
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"
  rw "github.com/redwood/inference-go"
)

func main() {
  client := rw.NewClient(rw.WithAPIKey("${RW_KEY}"))
  stream := client.Responses.Stream(context.Background(), rw.StreamOptions{
    Model: "redwood-infer-pro-v1",
    Input: "Attach FX rate for GBP->USD",
    Stream: true,
    Functions: []rw.FunctionDef{{
      Name: "fx_lookup",
      Parameters: map[string]interface{}{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": map[string]interface{}{
          "pair": map[string]interface{}{"type":"string"},
          "rate": map[string]interface{}{"type":"number"},
          "ts": map[string]interface{}{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},
        },
        "required": []string{"pair","rate"},
      },
    }},
    FunctionCall: "auto",
  })

  for ev := range stream.Events() {
    switch ev.Type {
    case rw.EventTypeFunctionCall:
      var payload map[string]interface{}
      json.Unmarshal([]byte(ev.Payload), &payload)
      fmt.Printf("got tool: %#v\\n", payload)
    case rw.EventTypeDelta:
      fmt.Print(ev.Chunk)
    case rw.EventTypeEnd:
      fmt.Println("stream closed")
    }
  }
}
```

Jules K.: Note: defining the JSON schema in Functions.parameters is critical to avoid model hallucinated fields and to make downstream ingestion deterministic. For Private, tooling that performs outbound calls must be deployed in a subnet with NAT/eip or use an adaptor inside the VPC.

Damian L.: Pricing roughs: hosted on-demand sample: $0.025 per 1k tokens -> 1M tokens ~= $25/mo. If they want sustained 500 qps peak and <100ms p95 SLA, recommend Dedicated reserved pool. Small reserved starting commit for that profile: ~$9k/mo (includes GPU infra + baseline support). If HSM KMS required on Private add ~15-25% uplift depending on vendor. I'll produce a 2-option quote (hosted vs 3mo reserved) and an expedited onboarding line for 2-week turn-up.

Priya R.: They asked about fallback semantics if reserved pool saturates during spikes.

Jules K.: Platform supports routing policies: prefer reserved, fallback to hosted-compatible. Fallback will map the model to a hosted-compatible variant; function calls still work but note potential KMS key visibility differences. Example policy snippet (console YAML):

```yaml
routes:
  - name: currencyflow-dedicated
    prefer: dedicated
    match: customer_id == "currencyflow"
  - name: currencyflow-hosted-fallback
    prefer: hosted
    fallback: true
```

Jules K.: Also mention eviction/quotas: when falling back, requests might face tokenization differences across model variants; include a short eval to ensure parity.

SecurityBot: Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sec/currencyflow/secq_497123.pdf and SOC2 summary. SAML attribute mapping template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/saml-attr-map.md. IP allowlist sample: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/ip-allowlist-template.md

Priya R.: Action items: 1) I'll request IDP metadata + egress CIDR + confirm HSM decision from customer (48h). 2) @Damian L. please prepare pricing slides for hosted vs 3mo reserved + expedited onboarding fee. 3) @Jules K. can you spin up a short canary with a quantized model (q4) to show latency/cost tradeoff?

Damian L.: On it. I'll attach slides here when ready.

Jules K.: I'll provision trial reserved capacity RW-POC-9007 and run a 15min demo for them with the Go snippet. Will include a small test harness that simulates 500 qps for 60s to show fallbacks.

Priya R.: Great. I'll email customer now with ask-list and sample Go code. Will loop back with responses. :thumbsup:
